faqs.question: Can I cancel?
faqs.answer: You can cancel up to 24 hours before departure.

faqs.question: How do I get there?
faqs.answer: Coach from Queenstown or drive and park at the terminal.

faqs.question: Is there wheelchair access?
faqs.answer: The main deck is step-free. Upper decks have stairs.
